rec.name: Product Title Badges (Badges Above Product Title)
rec.status: Built — delivered for feedback (June 2025); later marked as duplicate/done

what.text: A section that shows up to 3 pill-shaped badges directly above the product title, on both the product detail page and the product cards in collection grids. Badge text comes from per-product metafields. Each badge can have its own color scheme and an optional icon. Empty metafields hide the badge, and if all are empty the whole badge row is hidden. Screenshots show examples such as 'Top rated', 'Limited', 'Best match' (PDP/collection) and 'Pflegt und stärkt die Nägel' (a benefit pill with an icon on the live Health Routine PDP).

why.text: Short labels next to the product name give the buyer a fast read on the product's key claim before they read anything else. Labels like 'Top rated' work as social proof, 'Limited' adds mild scarcity/urgency, and benefit pills ('Nourishes and strengthens nails') communicate value. Placing them at the title level makes them visible in both grid scanning and PDP evaluation. Color-coded schemes (neutral/success/warning) let the label's tone match its meaning.

how.text: Build two implementations, because the theme handles the PDP and the collection card differently. (1) PDP: a custom section 'CRO | Title Badges' added to the product template above the title. Each of the 3 badge blocks has a color scheme dropdown, an icon image picker, and a dynamic-source badge text bound to a product metafield (Title badge 01/02/03). (2) Collection: a 'CRO | Product Title Badges' group in Theme settings > Collections, with per-badge color scheme and icon, plus global style settings. Both read the same three product metafields, so the same text appears in both places. Render a badge only if its metafield is non-empty, and render nothing if all are empty. Use pill styling with uniform padding and gaps, wrapping onto a second line on small screens. Optionally add a light fade-in, make sure badges don't overlap images, and keep text screen-reader readable.

items: Per badge (1–3): color scheme (Natural, Success, Warning)
Per badge (1–3): icon as image (e.g. SVG checkmark)
Per badge (PDP): badge text via dynamic metafield source (Title badge 01/02/03)
Color scheme definitions: text color and background color per scheme (e.g. Natural text #282828)
Visibility per context: PDP via the product template section, collection via Theme settings > Collections (separate controls)

dependencies.text: Three product metafields for badge texts (Title badge 01, 02, 03; example names badge_1–badge_3). OS 2.0 theme with a product template that supports custom sections and dynamic sources. Collection card badges require edits to the theme's product-card snippet plus theme settings. No external app. Source code zip and setup guide were delivered by the developer (not included here).

items: Product card CTR for products with badges vs. without
